No prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, executable commands, or unauthorized network behavior was found.

content.value_statement: Product teams need clear positioning, launch plans, and sales enablement before scaling. This skill turns product and market inputs into structured GTM strategy, battlecards, messaging, and launch plans.
actual_capabilities: Defines ideal customer profiles, buyer personas, and market segments for B2B SaaS companies.
Applies positioning frameworks to create value propositions and messaging hierarchies.
Structures competitive intelligence, battlecards, win/loss analysis, and objection handling.
Builds 90-day go-to-market launch plans with channels, milestones, and metrics.
Plans international market entry across the US, UK, DACH, France, and Canada.
Maps PMM metrics, dashboards, QBR sections, and monthly operating checklists.
limitations: It provides strategy frameworks, not live market research or verified competitor data.
It does not execute the referenced script ideas or monitor external websites.
Its examples assume B2B SaaS and Series A growth contexts.
Budget, KPI, and timeline examples must be validated against real company data.

use_cases.title: Refine Positioning
use_cases.description: Create a clear value proposition, messaging hierarchy, and persona-specific proof points for a SaaS product.

use_cases.title: Plan A Launch
use_cases.description: Build a 90-day GTM plan with launch tiers, channel tasks, enablement assets, and success metrics.

use_cases.title: Equip Sales Teams
use_cases.description: Create competitive battlecards, win/loss questions, demo guidance, and objection responses for revenue teams.

prompt_templates.title: Define My ICP
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a B2B SaaS product.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me define an ICP for a B2B SaaS product. My product is [product], customers are [current customers], average deal size is [ACV], and target regions are [regions]. Include firmographics, personas, pain levels, and validation checks.

prompt_templates.title: Create Positioning
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate work on messaging and differentiation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create positioning for [product] using our target customer [ICP], alternatives [competitors or status quo], unique attributes [attributes], and proof points [evidence]. Return a value proposition, messaging hierarchy, and persona messages.

prompt_templates.title: Build Launch Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced launch planning for a new product or feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a 90-day GTM launch plan for [launch]. Our audience is [audience], launch goal is [goal], budget is [budget], channels are [channels], and sales capacity is [capacity]. Include pre-launch, launch, post-launch, metrics, and enablement assets.

prompt_templates.title: Design Expansion Strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced international GTM and competitive enablement.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an international expansion and competitive enablement plan for [company]. Current markets are [markets], target markets are [targets], competitors are [competitors], and constraints are [constraints]. Prioritize markets, budget, localization, battlecards, and sales training.

output_examples.input: A Series A SaaS company needs positioning for a workflow automation product.
output: A prioritized ICP with firmographics, buyer roles, pains, and validation criteria.
A one-line value proposition connected to measurable outcomes.
A messaging hierarchy with benefits, features, and proof points.

output_examples.input: A marketing leader is preparing a major feature launch next quarter.
output: A launch tier recommendation based on expected impact and effort.
A week-by-week plan for pre-launch, launch, and post-launch work.
A metric dashboard covering traffic, MQLs, SQLs, pipeline, and adoption.

output_examples.input: A sales team needs help competing against an established vendor.
output: A battlecard with competitor strengths, weaknesses, win scenarios, and loss scenarios.
Objection responses that compare outcomes instead of attacking the competitor.
Win/loss interview questions for better market feedback.

best_practices: Provide real customer data, sales cycle data, competitor names, and product proof points.
State the target market, launch tier, budget, and sales capacity before asking for plans.
Review outputs with sales, product, and customer success before external use.
anti_patterns: Do not publish generic sample claims without evidence from customers or usage data.
Do not use competitive battlecards to make unverified claims about competitors.
Do not apply the Series A SaaS assumptions to unrelated business models without adaptation.

faq.question: What type of companies is this skill best for?
faq.answer: It is best for B2B SaaS companies, especially Series A or growth-stage teams building repeatable GTM motion.

faq.question: Can it create a full product launch plan?
faq.answer: Yes. It can structure pre-launch, launch, and post-launch work with channels, assets, owners, and metrics.

faq.question: Does it research competitors automatically?
faq.answer: No. It can organize competitive analysis, but users must provide current competitor data or authorize separate research.

faq.question: Can it help with sales enablement?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports battlecards, sales decks, demo scripts, objection handling, and sales training agendas.

faq.question: Does it support international expansion planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes market entry guidance for the US, UK, DACH, France, and Canada.

faq.question: What inputs improve the output quality?
faq.answer: Useful inputs include ICP notes, customer interviews, win/loss data, pricing, competitors, launch goals, and budget constraints.
